title: Fireman Sam and the cat on the roof.
lines: Fireman Sam lives in the little village of Pontypandy by the sea.
He is the best firefighter in the village.
Sam has a red fire engine.
Jupiter has a long ladder and a big water hose.
Elvis, who loves cooking, and Penny, who can make anything, also work at the fire station.
Norman is the naughtiest boy in the village.
He always has a new plan.
Norman wants to fly a kite.
But he also wants his cat to fly with it.
He ties a basket to the kite.
The cat is in the basket.
Norman, that's not a good idea, calls his mum.
She lands on the highest roof in the village.
The kite gets stuck in a tree.
The bell rings at the fire station.
Sam, Elvis and Penny quickly put on their suits.
Sam puts the ladder against the house.
She walks away to the chimney.
He takes a piece of fish out of his pocket.
Penny gets the kite out of the tree with a long pole.
Sam climbs down and gives the cat to Norman.
Animals don't belong on kites, Norman.
Elvis has made pancakes for everyone.
They eat together at the fire station.
Norman promises to be more careful from now on.
Tomorrow Norman will have another new plan.
